# Advisories pip-audit is told to skip (one ID per line, then the package it is for).
# Read by the CI backend job and `make check`; tests/test_dependency_audit.py fails once
# the lockfile moves past the version each entry is for, so none outlives its reason.
#
# Pillow 12.3.0: fixed only in 13.0.0, and every fastembed release (0.9.0 included)
# requires pillow<13. Pillow is reached through the PDF (pdfplumber), PPTX and OCR
# parsers, which run in the parse child process with a time limit. Remove these when
# fastembed allows Pillow 13 and the lockfile takes it.
CVE-2026-112395 pillow<13
CVE-2026-112397 pillow<13
CVE-2026-112400 pillow<13
CVE-2026-112404 pillow<13
CVE-2026-112895 pillow<13
